boundary: Reviewer authored Input/Worker production changes. This review covers only delivery-authored two new test modules; it is not independent review of production. No source edit/Cargo/Windows/CI performed.

findings.title: Admission control does not observe absence of data I/O
findings.evidence: Actual owned overlapped server, regular file and invalid handle are refused by Input::from_handle, but test does not use already available observer to assert no data-I/O phase. Thus is_err only verifies refusal, not the title before_data_io.
findings.requestedDelta: Use from_handle_observed with same actual handles and assert no Step/Peeking/Reading callback; no native-return replacement, new hook or rights change.

findings.title: Input parent lacks original-Child abnormal-exit guard
findings.evidence: Only the explicit 20-second timeout branch kills and waits the held Child. Earlier setup write, try_wait and event-processing panics drop Child without observed termination. The child 15-second watchdog is fallback, not parent observed cleanup. The helper test module already uses OriginalChild to handle these paths.
findings.requestedDelta: Give Input parent the same small RAII held-Child cleanup boundary; keep original natural success, timeout failure and 5-second limit. Never kill by PID or treat unknown as success.

verifiedByStaticRead: Stdio::piped standard input is actually inherited, original set_nowait AccessDenied is a negative control, no rights escalation.
Demand gate checks actual Queued(CHUNK), actual residual 3-byte read and absence of a new demand before consumption.
Test hooks only gate original thread after actual transitions/native results; real CancelSynchronousIo NOT_FOUND at before-Peek phase remains Pending.
ReadEOF obtains GetThreadIOPendingFlag on original held reader thread, then closes writer, waits actual Complete and requires Dirty; direct PeekEOF remains separate Clear then actual EOF consumption.
Worker tests invoke original Worker and real private Stream; false ACK blocked until zero-data completion, original first deadline persists, closed=true follows actual standard stdout cleared.

Same-build helper parent uses original helper-only MODE/capability hello path and normal read-only Stdio::piped; initialized request contains protocolVersion/capabilities/clientInfo; two stop(false) ACKs then later tools/list must use same still-alive child.
Six regular parents plus one explicitly ignored helper parent; two ignored child dispatchers selected only inside parents, no environment test switches. Child output not replayed into parent stdout.
limits: No actual Windows result yet. Gates show concrete production states, not every OS timing or partial native write.
No test invokes Tauri application, real Agent, screenshot pixels or production permission/broker acceptance.
Existing child watchdog/process handles do not by themselves prove every abnormal branch is retired; finding above remains explicit.
